subject.title: fix(deepgram): validate realtime base URL overrides, preserving ws(s):// endpoints

question: Should Deepgram realtime reject malformed and unrelated-scheme explicit base URL overrides immediately while preserving the released http, https, ws, and wss mappings?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but stricter validation changes upgrade behavior for existing invalid operator configuration, which repository policy treats as a maintainer-owned compatibility choice.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
options.body: Approve the stricter secret-safe error behavior, refresh the branch, and merge after exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep permissive handling
options.body: Decline the validation change and retain the existing downstream failure behavior for invalid overrides.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Approve the stricter secret-safe error behavior, refresh the branch, and merge after exact-head checks.
